summary: Frontend retest of the 2 fixes from iteration 42 in the /build 3D builder. AI was not triggered: /api/renders was aborted in most runs. In one Photo-mode run it was answered with a mock JSON that points at an existing catalog image, so no AI ran. (1) SKETCH BUTTON PLACEMENT: PASS. On mobile 390x844, 3D mode, sketch-start-button is at x36 y234 (40x40), at the top-left. It is left-aligned with the Photo/3D segment and sits 14px below it (segment y182-220). It overlaps nothing: no clash with the zoom-in, zoom-out, spin, reset or fullscreen buttons, the segment, the hint, or render-status. elementFromPoint at its centre returns sketch-start-button. Tapping it opens the gate when signed out; after signing up, the sketch pad opens. Cancel closes the pad and brings back the button and the 3D viewer. Desktop 1280x900 3D mode: the sketch button is at x36 y234, with no overlaps. Photo mode is unchanged on desktop and mobile: sketch is right above fullscreen at the bottom-right, 12px from the right and bottom edges, with no overlap with angle-bar or render-status. (2) SPLIT SHANK PAVÉ: PASS for the stray stones. Split shank with partial pavé no longer shows lone melee on the band; only the strand pavé remains. Full and 3/4 pavé on split shank stop cleanly below the strand starts, with no floating stones. Checked round 1ct and oval 2ct in the default, top and low views, plus a 2x zoom. NEW FINDINGS: (a) Bypass with partial pavé still has 2 lone melee per shoulder, the same artifact that was fixed for split shank. (b) Split shank with partial pavé now looks the same as polished split shank, so the +0.15ct pavé option has no visible effect. (c) In sketch mode, the 3D view-controls still render on top of the sketch pad toolbar. REGRESSION: all 11 styles render in 3D. Gold luminance std is 46.6-49.2. 0 page errors and 0 console errors; the only warnings are the textShadow* deprecation (react-native-web) and the dev-only Metro disconnect. 0 real AI render requests.

ui_bugs.issue: While sketching in 3D mode, the view-controls column stays visible and is drawn on top of the SketchPad. reset-view-button (314,412) covers the right end of sketch-note-input (32-358, y416-456). fullscreen-button (314,460) covers the right part of sketch-render-button (264-358, y464-504) and hides most of its 'Render' label. The Photo/3D segment (36-147, y182-220) also covers the start of the 'Draw your idea on the piece' banner (118-293, y190-205). Cause: line 266 renders controls(viewer,false) whenever isRing && mode==='live', without checking !sketching. The segment at line 244 also ignores sketching. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/design-canvas.tsx:244,266

issues: 2 lone melee per shoulder are still visible near the band ends, in the default and top views. Math: gap = 0.55 rad (31.5°), so clear = 43.5°. Partial pavé covers 40-140° with a step of about 4.3°, so only deg 40 and 44.3 (and 135.7 and 140) survive. Reference: build-ring.ts:454-455. Suggestion: if the run that survives on a side is shorter than about 4 stones, drop it. Or start the run at 90±clear and extend it outward by the same length, for all settings where gap > 0.

With clear = 51° and the partial range 40-140°, the band now gets 0 stones. Split shank with partial pavé looks the same as split shank with polished, apart from band thickness (compared side by side at 2x zoom). The customer pays +0.15ct pavé and sees no change. Suggestion: for split shank, shift the partial range outward (for example 90±(clear .. clear+50)) so the band pavé continues the strand pavé. Reference: build-ring.ts:168, 454-455.
There is still a step or seam where the split-shank band cap meets the strands.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web warns: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/watermark.tsx:31 (minor; this is a web-only warning).

action_items: Hide view-controls (and the canvas-mode segment) while sketching in 3D mode: add !sketching to design-canvas.tsx:266 and :244.
Bypass + Partial Pavé: remove the 2 lone melee per shoulder (build-ring.ts:454-455). Apply the same rule to every setting where gap > 0.
Split Shank + Partial Pavé: band pavé now renders 0 stones, so the option has no visible effect. Shift the partial range outward so some band pavé shows.
Minor: watermark.tsx:31 uses deprecated textShadowColor/textShadowRadius on web.
critical_code_review_comments: design-canvas.tsx:268: the live-mode override {bottom:'auto', top: 3xl+lg, left: md} is correct. Photo mode still uses the default right/bottom controls style.
build-ring.ts:455: when every angle is filtered out, an InstancedMesh with count 0 is created. This is harmless, but it can be skipped.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (both requested fixes pass; 1 new medium UI overlap in sketch mode; bypass partial-pavé strays)
